metadata.title: Twilight Horizon Portrait with Geometric Sans

retrievalProfile.description: A side-profile portrait of a figure with arms extended horizontally against a deep twilight horizon, featuring ultra-thin geometric typography in the lower-right quadrant.

recipe.visualDefinition: A profile view of a woman with long dark hair, arms outstretched toward the right, wearing a large metallic silver cuff. The background is a soft-focus landscape at dusk with a vibrant gradient of pink, purple, and deep indigo. The composition is anchored by a right-aligned block of thin, white geometric text.
coreVisualRelationships: Horizontal arm extension mirroring the horizon line
High-contrast silhouette against a luminous twilight sky
Right-aligned typography balancing the left-aligned subject
Metallic texture of the cuff contrasting with soft atmospheric lighting
coreInvariants: Twilight color palette (pink to deep purple)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left third of the frame, with arms extending across the center to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the metallic cuff serve as primary focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the subject's gaze and the line of the arms from left to right, landing on the typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper right and lower right, utilized for atmospheric depth and text placement.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep indigo and violet in the lower half and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Soft pink and lavender in the sky gradient.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Reflective silver on the arm cuff and crisp white for the text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark silhouette and the glowing sky; saturated purples in the mid-tones.

letterConstructionRules: Tight letter spacing for the main name, wider tracking for the subtitle
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'j' with a simple straight descender

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed over the dark landscape area for maximum legibility

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with varying tracking and size for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric circularity and thin strokes.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and high x-height.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a side-profile portrait of a woman with long dark hair, arms extended horizontally to the right, wearing a wide silver metallic cuff. Background is a blurred twilight landscape with a pink and purple sky gradient and dark ground.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned, ultra-thin geometric sans-serif text in white in the lower-right corner. Use lowercase for the primary name and wider-tracked lowercase for the secondary title below it.

mustRedesign: Avoid using the specific artist name
Ensure the landscape is generic and not a specific landmark

mustAchieve: Smooth color gradients in the sky

postGenerationChecks: Is the metallic cuff reflective and distinct?
Does the horizon line sit behind the extended arms?
Is the color palette restricted to twilight tones?
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject(Profile + Extended Arms) + Environment(Twilight Gradient) + Typography(Right-aligned + Geometric Sans + Hairline Weight)
